settings.title: Settings
settings.homeserver_url_helper: Enter this URL (or the server name) in Matrix apps like Element X, FluffyChat or Element Desktop.
settings.admin_password_helper: Change it after the first login; this field keeps showing the initial password.
settings.delegation_description: Other servers and clients look up the homeserver at https://{server_name}/.well-known/matrix/. Unless this module serves these paths (option below), publish the following documents there.
settings.host_helper: Synapse answers client and federation requests on this host name, port 443.
settings.server_name_helper: The domain in user IDs, like @alice:example.org. Leave empty to use the homeserver host name. It cannot be changed later.
settings.server_name_fixed: The server name cannot be changed after the first configuration.
settings.wellknown_helper: Adds a route for https://{server_name}/.well-known/matrix to this module. Other paths of that host stay untouched.
settings.accounts_description: Users of the selected user domain log in with their user name and password; their Matrix account is created at the first login. Without a user domain only local accounts exist, created by the server admin (for example with Ketesa). Public registration is always disabled.
settings.user_domain_not_found: The user domain does not exist
settings.web_apps_description: Each web app needs its own host name. Leave a field empty to disable that app.
settings.bridges_description: mautrix bridges connect Matrix with other chat networks. Users of this server start a chat with the bridge bot (for example @whatsappbot) and log in to their account there. A bridge image is downloaded when the bridge is enabled for the first time, which can take a minute.
settings.telegram_description: The Telegram bridge needs an API ID and API hash from https://my.telegram.org/apps.
settings.telegram_api_hash_set: A hash is stored; leave empty to keep it.
settings.mail_from_helper: Mails are sent through the cluster smarthost, if it is enabled. Empty uses noreply@<server name>.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Host name already used by another app
settings.hostname_already_used: Each host name can be used only once
settings.invalid_hostname: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.server_name_immutable: The server name cannot be changed
settings.invalid_email: Must be a valid email address
settings.invalid_number: Must be a number between 1 and 10240
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.calls_description: Element Call runs group and 1:1 video calls in Element Web, Element Desktop and Element X through a LiveKit media server on this node. The TURN server (coturn) helps clients behind strict NAT and firewalls, for classic 1:1 calls and for Element Call. Both need ports that clients reach directly; the module opens them in the node firewall. Behind a router, forward them to this node.
settings.calls_public_ip_helper: The address clients on the internet reach this node at, if it is behind NAT. Empty: LiveKit finds it with STUN, coturn announces the node's own addresses.
settings.calls_ports_description: Open or forward these ports to this node:
settings.invalid_ip_address: Must be a public IPv4 or IPv6 address
